status: working season structure; 8-part RexPrompt dramatic map of one two-act musical
seasonQuestion: Can Alex love Mira without turning love into a system he must understand and control?

actMap.Act I: Episodes 1-3: grace, pattern, pressure, comparison, fracture.
actMap.Act II: Episodes 4-8: grief, unrealized dreams, boundaries, separation, surrender, reconnection, social reframing, changed behavior.

episodes.title: Morning Light
episodes.summary: Alex experiences an ordinary morning with Mira as grace in The Sun Comes Through, then reveals in Figure It Out that he instinctively converts uncertainty into systems and proofs.

episodes.title: Still We Go
episodes.summary: The Weight of These Times turns the city into a pressure chorus. At home, Mira asks to be heard while Alex answers feelings with plans and fixes.

episodes.title: The Storm We Measure
episodes.summary: Tidal Waves of Love begins as gratitude and becomes comparison. Mira realizes she is being made responsible for stabilizing Alex; their relationship fractures when he tries to solve the conflict itself.

episodes.title: Empty Rooms
episodes.summary: Phantom Limb gives absence physical form. Plans We Never Made reveals that Alex's need to control love is tied to a larger fear of never becoming somebody.

episodes.title: Space
episodes.summary: Mira builds a free-form community workshop and sings Give Me Space. In Here I Am / There You Are, Alex asks to be caught while Mira offers care without surrendering autonomy.

episodes.title: Borrowed Time
episodes.summary: When Will I See You Again tracks separation without immediate repair. Cold Wind lets Alex admit the relationship was fading before the final rupture and stop arguing with the past.

episodes.title: No Need to Steer
episodes.summary: Weightless moves Alex from counting to embodied flow. A chance café encounter in Tangy, Sour lets Alex and Mira share memory without forcing a conclusion.

episodes.title: The Unfinished Score
episodes.summary: Empire Burn reframes private catastrophe-thinking as a cultural habit. Alex then enters Mira's workshop without taking over and offers a score with blank measures for whoever is present. The Sun Comes Through returns as a communal finale.
